verdict.rationale: Milvus's own overview docs give a single quantified comparison, 30%-70% better performance than FAISS and HNSWLib, plus scale claims of billions to tens of billions of vectors. The pack contains no actual benchmark report, latency figures, recall figures or methodology backing these claims. An old community comment that IVF performance matches FAISS concerns one index family in an earlier version, so it does not concretely refute the current claim. Missing for 10: published benchmark reports with methodology, measured latency numbers (p50/p99), recall-vs-throughput figures, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a platform-engineer, I can see published benchmarks or measured latency/recall numbers backing the database's performance claims

citations.quote: Compared to popular implementations like FAISS and HNSWLib, Milvus delivers 30%-70% better performance.
In 2022, Milvus supported billion-scale vectors, and in 2023, it scaled up to tens of billions with consistent stability
